T: Help me, I'm poor. Have a cupcake.
D: A maid of honour's life unravels as she competes with a rich new friend over the bride.
P: Serve dessert when Annie bakes her one perfect cupcake.
S: Almond meal and icing sugar folded into Italian meringue, piped, rested, baked at 145C for 14 minutes, sandwiched with raspberry ganache.
Fried battered cheese curds, crunchy outside and squeaky inside, with ranch dressing. Cut 400g firm cheddar or haloumi into 2cm cubes.
Annie's bakery that didn't make it
Cinnamon scrolls: yeasted dough with butter, brown sugar and cinnamon rolled, cut, proved, baked at 190C for 20 minutes, iced.
M: the big wedding Helen plans to the last detail
Chicken breasts brined an hour, roasted skin side down in butter then flipped into a 200C oven, finished with a white wine, lemon and thyme cream sauce, with a potato gratin and buttered greens.
the trip to Vegas that never makes it past the plane
Rigatoni cooked 2 minutes short, finished in a sauce of tomato simmered 20 minutes with garlic and chilli, tossed with torn burrata and basil just before serving.
W: the one cupcake she makes alone late at night
Vanilla bean cupcakes baked at 170C for 18 minutes, piped with a tall swirl of pale pink Swiss meringue buttercream, finished with a little sugar flower made from fondant.
K: Rosé wine, soda and a splash of grapefruit over lots of ice with strawberries. Fill 4 large wine glasses with ice and sliced strawberries.

s.how: Cut 400g firm cheddar or haloumi into 2cm cubes. Whisk 150g flour, 1 egg and 200ml cold beer into a batter, dip the cheese and fry at 185C for 1 minute until golden. Serve with 200ml ranch dressing.

s.note: Annie's bakery that didn't make it
s.how: Mix 400g flour, 7g yeast, 250ml warm milk and 50g butter and prove an hour. Roll out, spread with 60g butter, 80g brown sugar and 1 tbsp cinnamon. Roll, cut 12 and prove 30 minutes. Bake at 190C for 20 minutes and ice with 100g cream cheese beaten with icing sugar.

m.note: the trip to Vegas that never makes it past the plane
m.how: Simmer 2 tins crushed tomatoes with 3 sliced garlic cloves and chilli flakes for 20 minutes. Cook 500g rigatoni 2 minutes short and finish it in the sauce. Tear 2 burrata over the top with basil just before serving.

w.note: the one cupcake she makes alone late at night
w.how: Beat 125g butter with 150g sugar and vanilla bean seeds, add 2 eggs and fold in 200g self-raising flour and 125ml milk. Bake at 170C for 18 minutes. Whisk 2 whites and 120g sugar over hot water, beat in 200g butter, tint pale pink and pipe tall. Add a fondant flower.

d.how: Fill 4 large wine glasses with ice and sliced strawberries. Add 120ml chilled rosé and 40ml pink grapefruit juice to each and top with 60ml soda water.
